name: Life is Horror
source:
Humanity has left without a trace, leading to monsters roaming the world without restraint. Oddly enough, they seem rather content to pick up civilization where it left off! Leading more or less human lives, monsters have replaced humanity, including you.

Despite being the odd kid, your best friend Briar has stuck by your side since you two met. As you meet her on the first day, she gives you news of an upcoming party!

Play as Wint on her last year of school as you try to find her a date for the upcoming end of the year party! Despite being probably the last pick for a date, introduce Wint to would-be partners as you try to be the least awkward you can on your quest for true love.

Each character you meet will have a unique personality. Be yourself, be a sycophantic yes-man, or mess up entirely, each character will have something to say in response and surely won't be an easy catch given your past track record...

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lifeishorror/life-is-horror?ref=user_menu]Kickstarter[/url]]
